narrative.overview: Leonly feels like a carefully kept private archive rather than a social feed. Editorial display type gives memories emotional weight, while warm paper-like surfaces and restrained mauve accents keep the application calm, personal, and dependable. The component character is refined and tactile: fine warm borders define structure, soft ambient shadows lift only important keepsakes, and short movements acknowledge interaction without turning the shared history into spectacle.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-white canvases with dusty mauve and selective rose accents.
Fraunces for emotionally significant headings; Nunito Sans for all operational text.
Rounded, bordered surfaces with quiet depth and generous breathing room.
Mobile-first stacking that becomes editorially asymmetric on wider screens.

rules.name: The Rare Rose Rule
rules.body: Rose marks focus or emotional significance; it does not flood routine screens.

rules.name: The Memory Has a Voice Rule
rules.body: Fraunces names meaningful content; Nunito Sans operates the product.

rules.name: The Border Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use a warm border for ordinary structure; add shadow only when a surface needs narrative or modal prominence.

dos: Do keep memory content visually dominant over product chrome.
Do use warm borders, calm motion, and visible focus states to make interactions feel dependable.
Do preserve honest empty and waiting states with the same visual care as populated screens.
donts: Don't turn the palette into bright red romance branding or generic social-media gradients.
Don't use Fraunces for dense controls, metadata, or long operational copy.
Don't stack shadows on every card; depth is meaningful because most surfaces remain quiet.
